title: stachys recta subsp. leucoglossa
intro: Stachys recta subsp. leucoglossa, commonly known as Alpine Betony, is a perennial plant species within the mint family, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as a mild sedative, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The exact bioactive constituents may vary, but they are believed to contribute to the plant's therapeutic effects and overall medicinal value.
